scope: classtracker_stats.py whole read and pinned blob verified; original report class methods controlled with authored data, no file/pickle/chart/GUI activity

control_result.scope: Exact AST classes and authored snapshots, no sizing, pickle, output or charts

findings: Stats._init_sort never updates maxsize after choosing a timestamp. For snapshots100 then20, last positive timestamp2 chosen rather than peak1, and object tsize becomes20. Exact class control reproduced.
HtmlStats.relative_path uses raw prefix and leaves rel unset for unrelated path. Sibling prefix renders -other/a and unrelated path raises UnboundLocalError. Reproduced.

Stats holds live tracker index/snapshot references and caches sorted objects and snapshot.classes annotations without invalidation; subsequent live updates may not appear in existing reports. Static finding.

_merge_asized keys referents by name prefix before colon; distinct labels can coalesce. Newly appended refs are not added to local refs map, so repeated new keys in other.refs can remain separate. Static finding.

ConsoleStats.print_stats default limit1.0 slices one object; fractional limits use entire sorted length rather than class-filtered length. Documentation describes total tracked data percentage while implementation counts objects. Static finding.

Summary percent denominator is Snapshot.total, which can mean virtual process size, total measurable Python objects, or tracked subset. Pie Other subtracts class sums from asizeof_total even when that optional total is zero. No chart execution.
HTML chart plots object-size totals under Virtual Memory label; these are not interchangeable with process VSZ/RSS. Source snapshot prose does distinguish domains.
dump_stats stops periodic sampling, serializes two pickle objects directly, no atomic replacement; load_stats does not close a file it opens. No serialized input loaded, no output written.
